Bread and circuses never go out of style.
english.je_ce_orleans_dynasty_support_desc: We must take over the government before the Bonaparte dynasty falls!
english.fra_unrest.1.d:
Napoleon's mighty empire brought greatness, but never stability. The French people, proud and restless by nature, could never accept being mere subjects. When his successor softened the iron grip and abolished the terror campaigns, new problems emerged—ruling such a vast realm demanded everything from the throne itself.

Emperor Joseph, with his heart burdened by the weight of the empire, had a sudden death in 1832. His young, ambitious cousin and heir Louis quickly formed a new cabinet. He promised social equality, prosperity, and a constitutional order where a strong monarch would lead with the people's welfare at heart. 

 However, after two decades listening promises after promises from the Bonapartes, the French grow impatient. How much longer must they wait?
english.fra_unrest.1.f: 'The Empire is peace.' — Emperor Charles Louis Napoléon Bonaparte at his coronation ceremony in Reims Cathedral, 1832
english.fra_unrest.2.d: We have finally proven to the people that the reforms promised by the Bonaparte dynasty since 1829 are real and realistic. The vision of Bonapartism is not just about manipulates laws, agendas, or social conflicts to keep people quite and hopeless, but a truth based on ideas of a constitutional state and benevolent big government. \n\n At least to some extent, we have followed the teachings of Emperor Napoleon and found a balance between radical ideologies and the old ways, between elites and the masses, for the French nation and the French society.
english.fra_unrest.2.f: '...the law, in its majestic equality, forbids the rich as well as the poor to sleep under bridges, to beg in the streets, and to steal bread...' — Anatole France, The Red Lily
english.fra_unrest.2.1: When Paris in prosperous, Europe flourishes. When Paris in deficit, Europe declines.
english.fra_unrest.3.d: The demise of an empire is not always spectacular; it can also be silent. The Senate reform of 1835 perfected the concept of 'imperial citizens' rather than 'subjects,' and attempted (at least once again) to grant propertied citizens 'dignity, duty, and the right to vote.' From that moment on, the 'Frenchmen belonging to the dynasty and the state' of the post-revolutionary and Napoleonic era of autocracy disappeared. It was as if they had never existed, nor should they have. Thus, the reform of that empire and its self-demise in the process of reform became inevitable.
english.fra_unrest.3.f: 'The existence of a nation is a daily plebiscite.' — Ernest Renan, 'What is a Nation?'
english.fra_unrest.3.1: Without Napoleon, what do we have left?
english.ce_french_empire_has_ended: Did not become a #b Republic#! by the time the relevant [concept_journal_entry] ended.
english.ce_french_empire_has_not_ended: Became a #b Republic#! before the relevant [concept_journal_entry] was invalidated.
english.ce_french_empire_has_ended_alt: Chose a system other than monarchy or republic.
english.fra_unrest.4.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('monarchists_in_opposition').GetLeader.GetIdeology.GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('monarchists_in_opposition').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('republicans_in_opposition').GetLeader.GetIdeology.GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('republicans_in_opposition').GetName] have realized their common goal: to overthrow the current regime. Some die-hard supporters have even taken this a step further, supporting each other in various opposition activities such as court cases, printing leaflets, and forming cliques.
english.fra_unrest.4.f: 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend, isn't it? Of course, those scoundrels don't understand the direction of developments. Once we achieve our goal, we can burn the bridge.'
english.fra_unrest.4.a: To destroy the establishment, all parties must unite.
english.fra_unrest.4.b: It's better to be alone than in bad company.
english.fra_unrest.4.c: This cooperation is too forced and has no future.
english.fra_unrest.6.b: This is thanks to the soldiers, not the leaders.
english.fra_unrest.6.4: I hear that in the distant Western Qin, the iron fists elect the emperor, not the other way around.
english.fra_unrest.7.4: Entrepreneurs should have a higher status!
english.fra_unrest.8.d: In the cities of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective], a sentiment different from the usual [SCOPE.sCharacter('bonapartist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] is brewing. With the recent promotion of some grassroots politicians to high positions in the state, even the working class, who once only had the energy to work from dawn to dusk and cared little for neighborhood life, have begun to actively participate in community activities. It's as if by electing a high-ranking person of their choice, their housing problems of leaking roofs and chaotic tiles will immediately receive the state's help.
english.fra_unrest.8.f: 'Fallen houses will be managed, smelly water will be managed, too hot will be managed, too cold will be managed, infectious diseases will be managed, black intermediaries will be managed, and market bullies will also be managed! His Majesty is one of us!'
english.fra_unrest.8.1: The high and mighty Bonaparte is a Bonaparte of the past.
english.fra_unrest.8.2: There's nothing wrong with encouraging community politics...
english.fra_unrest.8.3: The essence of [SCOPE.sCharacter('bonapartist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] is to solve problems for the national economy and people's livelihood, not to chant scriptures and pray!
english.fra_unrest.8.4: Isn't this a kind of republican sentiment?
english.fra_unrest.9.d: The clergy of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] have been politically active since ancient times. Cardinal Richelieu is but the most famous among them, serving as advisors, bureaucrats, and propagandists in successive [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] courts. Even if scholars call the emperors' ruling art [SCOPE.sCharacter('bonapartist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] and explain it rationally and modernly, it does not prevent a part of the clergy from constantly exerting the influence of divine right of kings on the Bonaparte dynasty.
english.fra_unrest.9.f: 'Does not God demand that the monarch rule? Is the shepherd's power granted by the sheep? Does the shepherd not work wholeheartedly for the welfare and prosperity of his flock? Should it not be God, rather than mortals, who judges an incompetent king?'
english.fra_unrest.9.2: It's enough to allow some clergy to hold government positions, right?
english.fra_unrest.9.3: [SCOPE.sCharacter('bonapartist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] is inseparable from loyalty to the Lord.
english.fra_unrest.9.4: Render unto God what is God's, and unto Caesar what is Caesar's.
english.fra_unrest.10.d: As social sentiment continues to rise amidst today's political and economic reforms, some constitutional monarchist ideas, different from general Bonapartism, have begun to spread. Whether it's a simple reflection on it or some new trend of thought, it points to certain noble high-level officials in the government who are not from the Bonaparte family. The famous politician [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetFullName] is one of them.\n\nToday, [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetFullName], claiming to represent the entire [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetInterestGroup.GetName], published some comments on the current political situation in our country's major newspapers. Although [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetHerHis] tried his best to conceal his desire to criticize the current situation and packaged his words with various neutral analyses and data, it has caused a great stir in the folk and political circles of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective].
english.fra_unrest.10.f: #bold [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting]: 'My heart is sincere towards the [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetCustom('french_dynasty_name')]. But judging from the statistical data published by various universities recently, many phenomena in our society really cannot be said to be reasonable...'#!\n\n[SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting], as a prolific monarchist and a political figure of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetInterestGroup.GetNameNoFormatting], has long been known for his writings and speeches calling for reconciliation, and rarely expresses his criticism of actual policies. The people of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] have both supported and slandered [SCOPE.sCharacter('partisan_character').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s declaration this morning. (Continued on page two)
english.fra_unrest.10.2: Refute him with an editorial supporting the government!
english.fra_unrest.12.d:
The Bonaparte dynasty's use of the so-called 'revolutionary monarchy' banner to talk about the glory of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation always strengthens people's memory of the era of the Sun King.

Thus, since Emperor Joseph liberalized speech, there have always been voices among the people calling for the overthrow of the republican-era verdicts. These voices cry out for 'Citizen Louis,' calling for the restoration of the Bourbon family's citizenship and their readmission to the country. But the more this happens, the more vigilant the rulers of the Bonaparte dynasty become, only allowing the family to be sheltered by their cousins in [SCOPE.sCountry('slovenia_owner_scope').GetName], and never mentioning any pardon.

However, perhaps riding on the coattails of some social issue, the news of the death of the current head of the Bourbon family, Charles Philippe, who called himself 'King Charles X of France in exile,' has caused a stir in the country. Thousands of supporters of the old monarch from various provinces and villages have gathered on the streets of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] to petition for his body to be returned to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] for burial. Supporters of the republicans and the current regime have launched counter-protests to obstruct them.
english.fra_unrest.12.f: The uncrowned king is dead, but few are prepared to weep as they once did. Thousands call for the body of the exiled king to be returned to France for burial. 'Tradition,' they say. Thousands more swear to burn the corpse. 'Cholera,' they say.
english.fra_unrest.12.1: How could this Charles share power with you, what nonsense!
english.fra_unrest.12.2: Compared to the republicans who are quick to use the butcher's knife, I still prefer the old regime.
english.ce_allow_you_to_chose_bourbon_tt: Unlocks a new journal option: #b Bourbon Restoration#!
english.fra_unrest.13.d: After the outbreak of the Great Revolution, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people are always restless and happy to voice their demands. Just like earlier today, some people from unknown origins gathered in a church on the outskirts of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName]. Before the nearby police station could act, these people had already formed ranks. A little after lunchtime, they appeared collectively on the streets of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName], holding banners and red and white flags, shouting slogans like 'Republic' or 'Civil Rights' and some foul language cursing His Majesty. They marched in neat steps towards the imperial palace...
english.fra_unrest.13.f: 'Little Napoleon, rules with sycophants. The island barbarian is not the rightful ruler, still give us civil rights!'
english.fra_unrest.13.1: Send out the military and police!
english.fra_unrest.13.2: They're cursing Little Napoleon, what does that have to do with me, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_of_france_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting]?
english.fra_unrest.14.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] army is not a monolith. Even in the days of Napoleon the Great, people had their own interests and circles. Besides those with strong ties to the establishment and tradition represented by Bonaparte, rising political factions can always find a breakthrough in people's hearts. Wasn't Napoleon the Great himself once a beloved general and supporter of the 'Republic'?
english.fra_unrest.14.f: '[SCOPE.sCharacter('ce_french_republican_buying').GetFullNameNoFormatting], look at the streets, look at the world, think about yourself, think about this deposit slip, do you really want to stand against these things and history itself?'
english.fra_unrest.15.d: Republicanism is spreading in the streets and alleys, especially this year. Perhaps because of short-term stock market fluctuations that caused some factories to close, or perhaps because of some vicious cases arising from labor disputes, or perhaps due to the instigation of some mysterious forces, many opinion leaders of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ce_republican_ig').GetName] have taken to the streets, calling for a more open and popular sovereign government.
english.fra_unrest.15.f: 'Is the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ce_republican_ig').GetName] made up of cowards? True monarchy is when people are their own kings in their hearts!'
english.fra_unrest.15.1: Demons and ghosts, suppress them with tranquility.
english.fra_unrest.15.2: Launch a counter-protest to confront them.
english.fra_unrest.16.d: Earlier this month, a notorious pro-republican newspaper published an investigative report on Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('ce_republican_attacked').GetFullNameNoFormatting]. The author detailed his undercover interviews at a company clearly linked to [SCOPE.sCharacter('ce_republican_attacked').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s cronies. He discovered that this company acted almost like the authorities' black glove, not only operating morally reprehensible businesses like opium and usury within our country, but also participating in the trafficking of children and young female citizens.\n\nUnder the current legal system of our dynasty, the enslavement of citizens is explicitly illegal. But they have been profiting handsomely by leveraging their relationship with [SCOPE.sCharacter('ce_republican_attacked').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s cronies.
english.fra_unrest.16.f: '[SCOPE.sCharacter('ce_republican_attacked').GetFullNameNoFormatting] may genuinely know nothing about this. But he chose such people as his attendants, doesn't that also prove his incompetence?'
english.fra_unrest.16.1: Someone is about to 'commit suicide' to escape punishment.
english.fra_unrest.16.2: Let that fool leave the country and hide for a while.
english.fra_unrest.16.3: Find a way to attack the authenticity of the case, and then make that fool and the reporter disappear!
english.fra_unrest.17.d: Due to economic problems, popular discontent, social conflicts, or some other messy issues, the popular call for republicanism has finally reached a peak. Thus, after many years, scattered barricades and concentrated processions have appeared in Paris and the major provincial cities. Many high-level government officials are at their wits' end, not knowing how to mobilize resources to solve this major chaos...
english.fra_unrest.17.f: 'The truth is on its way, and nothing can stop it!'
english.fra_unrest.17.1: Alright! Alright! We should make concessions to them on key issues.
english.fra_unrest.17.2: Never compromise with them! We still have political power to mobilize.
english.fra_unrest.17.3: Raise funds from entrepreneurs, with money there is a way...
english.fra_unrest.17.5: Mobilize the influence of the nobles and gentry!
english.fra_unrest.18.d:
Louis-Philippe was the son of Louis-Philippe II, Duke of Orléans. After the outbreak of the Great Revolution, he fled to England for a time, and after England made peace with Napoleon, he traveled to the United States and the Great Ming, and was deeply impressed by the constitutional democracies of these countries. During his exile in the Southern Ming, he was hired as a French and Western history teacher for the crown prince, receiving the robes and salary of a Hanlin Academy scholar.

In early 1830, Louis-Philippe responded to Emperor Joseph's call for reconciliation and returned to the country. As the first great noble among the returning old aristocracy and an expert on the East, he was soon summoned by Emperor Joseph, became his advisor on Eastern affairs, and joined the Imperial Senate. He then came into contact with Crown Prince Louis Bonaparte and shrewdly infiltrated his circle of confidants. After Joseph's sudden death in 1832 and Louis's accession, Philippe leaped to become the Empire's Foreign Minister, playing an important role in stabilizing the regime of Napoleon III.

As the face of the Napoleonic regime, Foreign Minister Louis-Philippe presented a loyal and amiable image to the empire's internal and external audiences, and was beloved by the citizens for completing several important treaties that defended the empire's interests. Taking advantage of the emperor's indulgence, Louis and his supporters gathered a group of followers known as the 'Orléanists,' who subtly but persistently expressed their views on expanding constitutionalism and the electoral system in various salons and newspapers. To this day, the mark of Louis-Philippe and his supporters can be found in almost every corner of the empire's foreign and trade affairs.
english.fra_unrest.18.f: 'True opportunity only favors the prepared mind.'
english.fra_unrest.18.1: I believe that the statesmen of the Empire should have a higher loyalty.
english.fra_unrest.19.d: In the treacherous political situation of the empire, no one expected the Bonaparte dynasty to collapse almost overnight. As military and police forces supporting Louis-Philippe's ideas stormed the imperial palace and provincial governments, the Bonapartist leader [SCOPE.sCharacter('fra_old_ruler_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] fled in haste. Foreign commentators could not understand how the Orléanists, originally seen as a pillar of the constitution, could have come to oppose [SCOPE.sCharacter('fra_old_ruler_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] and usurp the empire of Napoleon the Great from within.\n\nMeanwhile, within the French Empire, the nascent Orléans dynasty, under [SCOPE.sCharacter('french_monarch_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], while rewarding merit, is also nervously taking over or reshaping the administrative structure of the empire to conform to their and their supporters' vision of a constitutional monarchy.
english.fra_unrest.19.f: The more things change, the more they stay the same. The barons of old owned forges and fields. Today, they control machines and warehouses of goods. For a wise king, it matters not which keys these barons hold, so long as the keys are in the right hands.
english.fra_unrest.19.1: My loyalty to the constitution and the citizens is above my personal honor or disgrace.
english.fra_unrest.19.2: Only resolute reform can save the French Empire.
english.fra_unrest.19.3: Only resolute reform can save the French economy.
english.fra_unrest.20.d:
Louis Bonaparte, calling himself 'Napoleon III,' is obsessed with his grand 'industrialization' plan. While he roams the capitalist circles of Parisian high society, rural France is dying. Soldiers who bought land and farms with their merits are losing money year after year due to the impact of industrial goods, on the verge of bankruptcy.

Because of this, a sentiment is spreading in the countryside, a feeling of betrayal. This sentiment was exploited by interested parties at the time of Charles X's death and reached a tipping point. Finally, using the opportunity of Charles X's coffin being returned for burial and the pressure from conservative and peasant protests, the new leader of the Bourbon family, the successor of Saint Louis, [SCOPE.sCharacter('FRA_ce_bor_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], announced that he had reached an agreement with the Bonapartes to return to his homeland in exchange for renouncing the 'exiled French throne.'

After a period of preparation, [SCOPE.sCharacter('FRA_ce_bor_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] arrived in Paris last Saturday and appeared at the regular mass at Notre Dame the next day. Despite the advance deployment of military and police to monitor and control, the scene still attracted a large crowd of citizens...
english.fra_unrest.20.f: '...What the legitimate monarchs of Europe must understand is... our real problem is that our souls no longer yearn for salvation, it is the life-and-death struggle with the heathens (especially the Ming people) in all fields, it is that we no longer use the sacred order to define our own and our subjects' positions...' — 'Letter from Barcelona, December 26, 1831' by the Bourbon heir Charles-Philippe (King Charles X of France in exile)
english.fra_unrest.23.d: Due to the complete disappointment of the government with the Bonapartist regime, a swift coup brought [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] to power smoothly. Surprisingly and expectedly, the heir of the Bourbon family did not choose a traditional lavish ceremony, but appeared at the coronation in a simple black cloak like a clergyman and the old robes of Charles X. After a morning of devout worship and meetings with representatives of towns and the church, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe|U] was anointed in the Reims Cathedral and crowned as the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
english.fra_unrest.23.f: 'Divine Providence has called me to this sacred land to assume the great responsibility of the King of France. Before the altar of the Lord who weighs the many monarchs and nations with one and the same heavenly balance, I promise to be loyal to the charter of this land, the sacred order, and Christian civilization, and I once again solemnly swear to uphold it.'
english.fra_unrest.23.1: Long live the successor of Saint Louis!
english.fra_unrest.23.2: If rule is not absolute, there is absolutely no rule.
english.ce_de_Bourbon_bar: The Bourbons are in the country
english.fra_unrest.21.d: The opportunity to change to a new dynasty has been missed, and now the political situation in France is sliding in a direction unimaginable to the former monarchists...
english.fra_unrest.21.f: 'Stupidity lies in the haste to draw conclusions.' — 'A Reply' by Gustave Flaubert
english.fra_unrest.22.d: The opportunity to change to a new dynasty has been missed, and now the Bonapartes have stabilized their position. The secret support gathered among our leaders is rapidly dissipating, as if it never happened.
english.fra_unrest.22.f: 'Stupidity lies in the haste to draw conclusions.' — 'A Reply' by Gustave Flaubert
english.ce_french_support_dynasty_button_desc: The path of Bonaparte is the only way to the unity and prosperity of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation. Revolutionary monarchy and Napoleonic constitutionalism are the only way to achieve both stability and justice.
english.ce_french_against_dynasty_button_desc: Either revolution or empire. Any compromise is to numb the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] citizens. We are a nation that dares to be independent and is good at self-defense, and we absolutely do not need a tyranny that threatens our lives to rule over us!
english.ce_french_orleans_dynasty_button_desc: There is a force in Bonaparte's government that does not belong to the hypocritical revolutionary dictatorship, nor to the bloody republicanism, nor is it a supporter of the old regime. It symbolizes a British-style constitutionalism, a moderate, stable but resilient social form.
english.je_ce_orleans_dynasty_support_reason: Napoleon's descendants and their military supporters have a natural arrogance that makes them unsuitable for a stable and prosperous constitutional government. The world today is one of constitutionalism and reason, no longer a world that can be dominated by a military regime. Let alone for France to lead the Western world to victory in the East-West confrontation.
english.ce_french_bourbon_dynasty_button_desc: The revolution was a storm that almost destroyed the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation. Our traditions of piety, loyalty, elegance, and chivalry have all been harmed by it. The subversive ideas and corrupt practices that followed have poisoned us to this day, leading us further and further away from the kingdom of God. This era cannot continue. We must have the glorious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] monarchy return.
english.je_ce_bourbon_dynasty_support_reason: The Bonapartists and the Republicans are equally obsessed with the ravings of 'revolution' and 'civil rights.' And since its birth, this raving has brought nothing but slaughter, trampling, and destruction to humanity. It turns ruler and subject against each other, father and son against each other, makes peasants and soldiers kill their officers, and causes a country's economy to decline due to strikes and barricades. Christian civilization is in a life-and-death race with the atheists of the East, and we will not allow such ideas to continue to rage. We should welcome the return of the true king appointed by the sacred order!

english.ce_gov_fanwang_guo_state_desc: Under this form of [concept_government], the state represents the interests of its endowed monarch and noble family, but often also contains representative institutions made up of local gentry, scholars, and examination electors (commoners who gained suffrage through the examinations).
english.gov_ce_chinese_fed_republic_desc: Under this form of [concept_government], the state is a representative republic jointly constituted by all peoples of the country, representing the shared interests of enfranchised voters and all national communities. It stands as the political voice of universalist and civic republican thought among humankind.
english.ce_gov_chinese_subject_republic_desc: Under this form of [concept_government], the state generally represents the will and interests of its suzerain and local collaborators, and is governed by a locally elected leader.
english.ideology_ce_qin_royalist_leader_desc: #lore This leader believes that the state and all its people should form an efficient, unified, and egalitarian collective order. They oppose uncontrolled movement of wealth, capital, and industry, and generally support a powerful political family as hereditary head of state!
english.ideology_ce_qin_royalist_desc: #lore This group believes that the state and all its citizens should form an efficient, unified, and egalitarian collective order. english.je_ce_war_to_opium_reason: An excessive influx of opium is poisoning our people, and we must stop this.
english.possible_je_ce_war_to_opium: This journal was triggered against us by a hostile power while there is a massive amount of @opium! opium in the [concept_market] which we are the [concept_market_owner]...

Its #b Progress Bar#! changes monthly based on opium market scale, bans, standard of living, turmoil, laws, and national strength. While active, the country suffers #n administrative and political strain#! and periodic social incidents; success grants long-term national bonuses, while failure causes severe penalties and their [concept_primary_cultures] gains [concept_obsession] on @opium! Opium .
english.ce_opium_events.2.d: With previous officials' ignorant, the poison of opium has penetrated into the bone marrow of our country. It not only is destroying the health of our citizens but also our wealth. In order to save the future of our nation and our people, we must take drastic measures to win this war without gunpowder!
english.ce_opium_events.2.f: I shall dedicate my life to the country; I will not evade doing so just to avoid misfortune!
english.ce_opium_events.2.a: We must overcome this major society crisis.
english.ce_opium_events.3.d: Our nationwide crackdown and blockade on opium has achieved unprecedented victory. The people have finally awakened from the haze of drugs, and the state's administration and construction have also ushered in a new lease of life.
english.ce_opium_events.3.f: A country without drugs is a truly great country.
english.ce_opium_events.4.d: Our efforts have failed completely. Opium has spread across the country like a plague. The army has lost its combat effectiveness, the workers and peasants are languishing, and the social order is on the verge of collapse.
english.ce_opium_events.4.f: We have lost this war, and the future of the nation.
english.ce_opium_events.5.d: Since we no longer control the relevant markets, the systematic crackdown on opium proliferation has been temporarily suspended. However, the social impact left by this anti-drug campaign still echoes long in this land.
english.ce_opium_events.5.f: This unfinished war has changed many.
english.ce_opium_events.6.d: Inside the opium dens, smoke is lingering, and countless addicted citizens are withered and confused about day and night. These lawless gray areas are devouring the foundation of our society.
english.ce_opium_events.6.b: As long as they don't cause trouble, let them be.
english.ce_opium_events.7.d: Some factory owners have secretly lured workers to smoke opium to numb their dissatisfaction with the harsh working conditions and excessive hours. The workers waste away in the toxic smog, like walking corpses.
english.ce_opium_events.7.f: As long as you give them a puff, they can keep working.
english.ce_opium_events.7.a: Pressure law enforcement to investigate this!
english.ce_opium_events.8.t: Influence of the Opium Chamber of Commerce
english.ce_opium_events.8.d: The massive opium trade has spawned a group of wealthy merchants and gang bosses, who have even begun to use money to intervene in our country's political process, trying to bribe key figures in the ruling group.
english.ce_opium_events.8.f: Drug money is corrupting the foundation of power.
english.ce_opium_events.8.a: Mark these corrupt elements as untrustworthy!
english.ce_opium_events.9.d: Tempted by the high profits of opium, more and more emerging gangs are taking drug trafficking as their main business. They have built a tight underground network, not only evading taxes but also triggering continuous violent conflicts.
english.ce_opium_events.9.f: Wealth circulates in the dark corners.
english.ce_opium_events.9.a: Implement a severe crackdown locally, at all costs!

english.ce_poland_events.1.d: The Polish delegation in Krakow has submitted a memorandum to us. On the surface, they respect the 1829 accord regarding the Polish 'provisional autonomous territory,' but between the lines, their deep resentment is evident. They claim their Polish territories are being oppressed, hinting that the 1829 settlement was merely the great powers' expedient masquerade. This challenges not only our territorial holdings but the legitimacy of the entire compromise framework. We must weigh our relationship with the Krakow regime against the attitudes of other great powers.
english.ce_poland_events.1.f: Damn the Poles! Isn't the accord of 1829 good enough for them? If they want true independence, let the Russians and Austrians deal with them. Or perhaps... we could show them what true independence actually entails.
english.ce_poland_events.1.a: Make concessions. Maintain order and preserve compromise with the great powers.
english.ce_poland_events.1.b: Take a firm stand. Demonstrate our support for Polish self-determination, regardless of what the great powers think.
english.ce_poland_events.2.d: Intelligence from Warsaw brings shocking news. The Polish leadership has finally abandoned the pretense of the 1829 settlement and issued an ultimatum to the great powers: either recognize Poland as a sovereign nation or face armed conflict. This is not merely a provincial's challenge to empires—it questions the entire 1829 framework. The conservative great powers will inevitably respond. We face a stark historical choice: whether to support Poland's self-determination, knowing it means standing against most of Europe.
english.ce_poland_events.2.f: 'The Poles have lost their minds,' our foreign minister reports. 'They thought the chaos in the East gave them an opportunity. Perhaps they were right. But at what cost does European need to pay for a Polish justice?'
english.ce_poland_events.2.a: Retreat. Preserve order and suggest Poland abandon its independence ambitions.
english.ce_poland_events.2.b: Support Poland! Even in opposition to most of Europe, an independent Poland is worth this price!
english.ce_poland_events.3.d: Poland's independence breakthrough transformed the 1829 settlement beyond recognition. This nation, long suppressed by the great powers, has finally achieved sovereignty through blood and resistance. Krakow is now a true capital, not a provincial administrative seat. This breakthrough does not merely change Poland's future—it sends a clear message to all of Europe: the force of national self-determination has become unstoppable. The age of complete suppression by concert and compromise is ending. A new Europe is taking shape, with Poland as the vanguard of this transformation. This decision will inevitably provoke the wrath of the conservative powers, but Poland's revival is now irreversible.
english.ce_poland_events.3.f: Poland lives! Her children have awakened from the grave of great power dominance, and her flag flies over Warsaw in freedom—on this day, all of Europe heard the voice of a newly liberated nation.
english.ce_poland_events.3.a: Poland is free. The old era has ended, and a new one begins.
english.ce_poland_events.4.d: Our security apparatus has uncovered a hidden conspiracy. Agents from #bold [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_from_country').GetName] #! have been secretly funding radical factions and dissidents in our country under the guise of 'maintaining order,' attempting to destabilize us from within. Those hostile to Polish independence cannot tolerate us supporting their ambitions. Other great powers are coordinating with them—together they are applying coordinated military and economic pressure against our supporters. This is not merely targeting Poland; it serves as a warning to all states that dare break the 1829 framework.
english.ce_poland_events.4.a: Strengthen internal security and expose these activities. This is an attack on our independence.
english.lost_progress_ce_poland_war: [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_to_country').GetName]: Reclaim and war related [concept_journal_entry] progress #R lost significantly#!
english.ce_poland_events.5.d: We attempted to exploit the Eastern chaos to pressure those opposed to Polish independence, hinting that we would coordinate with Oriental powers if they did not respect Polish sovereignty. But we miscalculated. The great powers opposed to Polish independence have formed a unified alliance. The Polish forces we armed collapsed under coordinated pressure from multiple empires. The cost of backing Polish independence may be far heavier than we initially calculated.
english.ce_poland_events.5.a: This gamble failed. We underestimated the determination of the great powers to maintain order.
english.ce_poland_events.5.f: “Have you seen that Polish shopkeeper lately? I got trouble with my drinks you know.”\n\n“I saw him last Tuesday, he was walking down to an alleyway...”
english.ce_poland_events.6.d: The Polish Question has become the justification for every great power's military expansion. Our army leadership unanimously calls for increased defense spending. Whether constructing steelworks, establishing arms factories, or building explosives plants—all these industrial facilities are now viewed as essential for confronting the future wars unleashed by Poland's independence. Each choice represents a strategic judgment on coming conflicts. And our decision will shape the entire European arms race trajectory.
english.ce_poland_events.6.f: 'Poland has opened Pandora's Box,' our military advisor warns. 'Russia is increasing its standing army, Austria is upgrading artillery, Britain is strengthening its navy. If we don't proceed with military modernization immediately, we will be hopelessly outmatched when the moment arrives.'
english.ce_poland_events.6.a: Construct a Steel Mill—strengthen our industrial base for future warfare.
english.ce_poland_events.6.b: Construct an Arms Factory—ensure our military equipment quality.
english.ce_poland_events.6.c: Construct an Explosives Plant—enhance our artillery advantage.
english.ce_poland_events.7.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_claim_state_target').GetCapital.GetName] has long occupied part of what the Poles call Polish territory. We have tried to undermine its rule there to serve our strategic aims in Eastern Europe. But when war is truly at the doorstep, are we genuinely prepared for prolonged confrontation with [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_claim_state_target').GetCapital.GetName]?
english.ce_poland_events.7.f: '...The purpose of this conference is to establish a treaty framework that does not begin from a state of war, not to proclaim a Pax et treuga Dei...' - French Regent Joseph Charles Bonaparte, Krakow, 1829
english.ce_poland_events.7.a: We will not pull chestnuts from the fire for [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_from_country').GetCapital.GetName].
english.ce_poland_events.7.b: Notify the military to prepare. Europe is heading for war.
english.ce_poland_events.10.d: Poland's breakthrough from the constraints of the 1829 settlement represents a rupture in the post-Napoleonic European order. A nation long suppressed by the great powers has finally achieved sovereignty through armed struggle. Krakow is no longer a provincial seat but a true capital of a sovereign state. This breakthrough signals not only Poland's transformed future but proclaims to all Europe: when the great powers' united front to maintain order shows cracks, the force of national self-determination becomes unstoppable. An old era has ended, and a new Europe is forming, with Poland as a harbinger of this coming age.
english.ce_poland_events.10.a: Poland has achieved independence. An old era has ended; a new one begins.
english.ce_poland_events.11.d: Poland's independence dream was crushed under the united pressure of the great powers. Though the 1829 settlement was controversial, time proved its viability—whenever Europe's power brokers unite to maintain order, no force of national self-determination can overcome their united opposition. The Poles awoke from their brief independence fever only to discover themselves once again in the shadow of empires. This second defeat did not merely shatter the Polish restoration movement; it demonstrated that in an era when the great powers close ranks, the path to independence has been sealed shut. Poland's fate is again decided by the concert of great powers.
english.ce_poland_events.11.a: The dream was crushed by the united pressure of empires. History once again chose order over freedom.
english.ce_polish_lost_homeland_in_our_tag_tt: Polish lost all their [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homeland$')] in our territory
english.ce_poland_events.12.d: The Polish Question is now defunct. Whether due to new developments in the East, shifts in the balance of power among European great powers, or the final collapse of the 1829 framework, Poland ceased to be the pivotal issue of European politics. All those who fought for Polish independence, all those who opposed it, discovered their efforts have become obsolete. Europe has entered a new era, and Poland has become merely a footnote in the margin of this age. The great powers have redirected their gaze elsewhere, and the Polish Question is no longer worth historical attention.
english.ce_poland_events.12.a: An era has ended. History moves on without sentiment.
english.ce_poland_events.13.d: Recently, diplomats and overseas military personnel from [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_strong_power').GetName] made secret contact with representatives of Poles abroad, providing a concentrated wave of funding and intelligence support to the Polish national movement.
english.ce_poland_events.13.f: “Take this, and this as well. These are all for your personal protection, so you must not use them for any dangerous activities! Especially not against... certain people. It would be most unfortunate to cause an international incident,” said the mysterious man in a suit, speaking with a [SCOPE.sCountry('ce_strong_power').GetName] accent, to a Polish radical.
english.ce_poland_events.13.a: An era has ended. History marches forward without mercy.
english.ce_poland_events.97.d: In 1828, as Napoleon the Great fell ill and could no longer govern, his eldest son François was appointed regent by the Senate, later became the Emperor François I after his father's death. Thus the age called the 'Napoleonic' came to an end. The empire without its emperor teetered on the edge of collapse. But unexpectedly, the Roman King proved diplomatically capable, and with his councilors' assistance, stabilized the realm. For a time, the tension across Europe eased by a series of conferences in autumn 1829. What emerged from these conferences was a system known as the 'Polish Consensus.' Its purpose was to finally resolve the deeply disputed Eastern European-Polish question (by establishing a Polish state centered on Krakow rather than Warsaw), while uniting European powers against the world empire of the East. However, as Kaifeng and Nanjing fell into successive crises and François I died in his prime, European powers' pressure suddenly lessened, and their hidden divisions resurfaced. Around this Eastern European Polish state, new clouds of war began to gather slowly.
english.ce_poland_events.97.a: Polish rise benefits Eastern European balance of power.
english.ce_poland_events.97.f: 'Hereafter, the fate of the European shall no longer rest upon the will of European nations, but rather upon Nanjing and Paris......' - Prince Metternich, Moscow, 1829

english.flavorUSM.1.d:
The Ming banner may still symbolize boundless eastern glory on this Earth. Under sun and moon, the hegemonic states of Northern Ming measured themselves and the world on a scale even more radical than Han and Tang, permanently reshaping power across the World Island. Yet for people who endured centuries of Ming-era regional warlord politics, the royal house of Zhu brought blood and tears equal to its glory.

After a new Yumen wind blew from the northwest - where Chen Dongyang and his Zhongren (Civic) Republicans, supported by Prince Zheng Qin of Wu, launched top-down reforms - the reaction of the Zhu house, old court retainers, and hereditary magnates became ever more glaring. Land, debt contracts, forced conscription: these, denounced by republicans as tools by which men consume men, came under sharper criticism for leaving villages empty and broken.

At this once-in-a-millennium turning point, the wise and cunning might look to the south. Hangzhou - city of Ming exploration into the New World, Europe, the Islamic sphere. That's the seat of the prince of Wu that once saved the dynasty from northerner ambitions now sits amid a chaotic arena of public opinion, waiting for history's torrent to surge again.
english.flavorUSM.1.f: In all under Heaven, shrines that benefit not the people should receive not thy sacrifice...\n- Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Ming, Edict on Removing Honorary Titles
english.flavorUSM.1.1: The wind howls and horses scream. The dying sound of a greater state.
english.flavorUSM.2.d: Compared with total explosion of contradictions, decisive Southern Court statesmen delayed imperial collapse through a sequence of hard choices, easing direct confrontation between republicans and conservatives. Even so, this survivor crawling out of four centuries of warlord politics also lost much. The age of war-peace confrontation ended. Yet opponents, regional discrimination among old feudatory populations, and new radical groups still move in the shadows of the new era, casting a heavy fog over this country - and the whole East - on its road to the future.
english.flavorUSM.2.f: In ancient times the people followed order without rulers...\n- Qianfu Lun
english.flavorUSM.2.1: At least we saved our own destiny.

english.flavorUSM.4.t: The Ming–Wu Succession: Zheng Zhao’s Audience
english.flavorUSM.4.d:
In the spring of 1678, Zheng Zhao—later Emperor Wuzong of Wu, then Duke of Wu, Ming’s Nanjing Protector and Minister of Rites—announced that he would visit the emperor after a succession of victories at home and overseas. The ruler of Yan at Tianjin, victorious in the Great Constitutional War thirty years earlier, still stood at the height of his power. Yet Zheng’s determination overcame his ministers’ warnings and his enemies’ threats. He set out in June.

Nothing comparable to this procession had been seen in the nearly three centuries of Northern Ming’s military governors and princely states. Pressure from Yan, Qin and Qi limited Zheng to five thousand guards and a handful of officials, but the entourage included the finest of Wu’s forces: marines from the Southern Seas, Japanese swordsmen, early Jurchen grenadiers, and even exiled nobles of the Far Eastern Yin seeking imperial redress and military aid. They carried treasures gathered during a century of Wu expansion across the world, while nearly ten thousand labourers hauled tribute rice from Annam and Cambodia. Beyond the procession lay a Central Plain kept close to famine by local fighting and the exactions of military governors and transport officials.

After returning, Zheng Zhao adopted the title of Supreme Lord. Wu and its colonies entered a period of rapid growth as refugees arrived from both north and south. Zheng and his successors pressed their centralising reforms and the commercialisation of land ever harder, securing the foundations of our authority over the Southern realm and its many states. Wu’s advance has continued to this day...
english.flavorUSM.4.f: I had heard that the Zhu Son of Heaven held Heaven’s mandate, a divine dragon descended among men. The founding emperor rose from beggary, destroyed foreign rule and restored the Chinese heartland. His achievements would outlast the inscriptions of history. Though virtue might decline, the mandate seemed unchanged. Yet today I have seen him: the Zhu boy is mortal too.\n—Zheng Zhao
english.flavorUSM.4.1: Yao and Shun yielded the throne; Tang and Wu won it by revolution. Heaven’s favour rests with virtue among the people and service to humanity, not one family or an unbridgeable division between ruler and ruled.

english.flavorUSM.5.d: Chen Dongyang (courtesy name Manyue, 1772-[Date.GetString|v]) was a representative figure of civic republican thought during the Western Qin Great Revolution and a founding hero of its short-lived revolutionary republic. Forced into exile from the state he built, he later cooperated with southern progressives and, as chief minister of Southern Ming, became a key leader of modernization reform.\n\nYet reform brought not only prosperity but also severe political turmoil and resistance from powerful local interests. After core political and economic reforms were largely completed, Zheng Qin and allies grew weary of republican ideals beyond Chen's control. Having once declared 'what I desire, I shall take and hold alone,' Zheng Qin dismissed Chen earlier this year and secretly ordered Zheng (Tokugawa) Jiaqi to monitor him. Ultimately, on [Date.GetString|v], while Chen sailed to lecture in the Far East Continent, a retained Wa assassin named Zheng Liulang poisoned him aboard ship.
english.flavorUSM.5.f: A great state is not in vast mountains and rivers...\n- On the Great State, Chen Dongyang
english.flavorUSM.6.d: Chen Dongyang is dead. Southern republicans have lost the leader of their reforms, while the cabinet and Six Ministries must redistribute his responsibilities. Provincial delegates still debate reform’s future in the Assembly of Rites, but Hangzhou is already courting the officials left without their leader.
english.flavorUSM.6.d1:
Chen Dongyang (courtesy name Manyue, 1772-[Date.GetString|v]) was a representative figure of civic republican thought during the Western Qin Great Revolution and a founding hero of its short-lived revolutionary republic. After being forced to leave the country he founded, he cooperated with southern progressives and became a key leader of Southern Ming modernization as chief minister.

Yet reform brought not only prosperity but severe political turmoil and resistance from local powerholders. As political and economic reform neared completion, Zheng Qin and his allies grew fearful of republican ideals beyond their control. Ultimately, on [Date.GetString|v], while Chen Dongyang was departing for the Far East Continent to lecture, an unidentified Wa ronin shot and killed the republican leader on deck.

After Chen's death, southern republicans who had followed him immediately fell into mutual accusations and dispute.
english.flavorUSM.6.f: A great state is not in vast mountains and rivers, not in number of people, not in quantity of iron and gold. It lies in nurturing life, standing with the people, and governing production. Taking boundless heaven and earth as its outer wall and the right path as its inner city, even a single city, a single ward, a single corner may still be a great state.\n- On the Great State, Chen Dongyang
english.flavorUSM.7.d:
In late Southern Ming, armed forces were chiefly divided between Western Office and Southern Office. Unlike Zheng's Southern Office, the Western Office lacked a single dominant political leader and functioned as a loose alliance led by Sichuan Shu, Hubei Chu, and Guangxi Huai. Once, Zheng Diaojin was its rising star - foremost strategist under Zhu Banbo. Banbo's charisma and command could make men betray decaying lineage and embrace civic republicanism in the south.

Yet Heaven seemed tired of the Ming story: Chen Dongyang and Zhu Banbo, two pillars of the age, fell without warning. The men who followed Diaojin from Xi'an to Monan, back to Xi'an, and then south of the great river scattered to their own fates. In a blink, it seemed only he remained who could still glimpse the summit of republican order.

So be it. Dreamers of the future failed in France, failed in Qin, and Ming now seems destined to fail as well. Justice in history is known to fail again and again - but if the cause truly follows history's tide, persistence will one day prevail. What Yue Fei and Wen Tianxiang could not do, Zhu Yuanzhang did. And Diaojin may not even need such sacrifice, for somewhere in the western mountains there may still be an old friend.
english.flavorUSM.7.f: Citizens, do you want a revolution without revolution?\n- Robespierre, 5 November 1792
english.flavorUSM.7.1: People give up, people flee, yet history still moves forward - if not today, then tomorrow.
english.flavorUSM.8.d: In 1850, the Ritual Assembly proclaimed that Zheng's Wu had replaced Ming. The Shu Prince Zhu Shenhui and Guangxi (Huai) Prince Jingyin rebelled; Jingyin proclaimed a restoration era 'Fuzhao.' The assembly dispatched Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, Zheng (Tokugawa) Jiaqi, and Wu (Ii) Naosuke to suppress them. Huai fell in March. Next year Shu general Xiao Huli died of illness; minister Wei Jian held old Chengdu and died cursing traitors with sword in hand. The Shu Prince fled south to Dali.\n\nAfter Chengdu's fall, western troops scattered. Zeng and Wu then had southern troops seal Sichuan prefectures for three days, sweep the land, and kill any robust civilians found outside. Chengdu, Jiange, Meizhou and others were violently looted. Those resisting were slaughtered wherever seized. The Jinsha ran red for weeks. The Zheng emperor reportedly showed displeasure, but issued only mild admonition.
english.flavorUSM.8.f: ...In Year Three of Tianyan...\n- New Chronicles of Huayang
english.flavorUSM.8.1: Those western rebels who speak of 'revolution' think bloodshed alone is courage. They read too little Eastern history.
english.flavorUSM.9.d: In 1852, Zeng Guofan and Zheng Jiaqi entered Yunnan. The Shu prince surrendered bare-chested, was reduced to Marquis of Dali, and retained stipends. Jingyin, usurper of Huai, was exiled to Kunlunzhou (South Africa) for high treason; his Zhu surname was stripped and changed to 'Zhi.' Thus ended the so-called 'Twin Jing National Crisis.' That winter, Zheng Diaojin, former vice minister of rites and administrator of Huguang, rebelled with disciples and six thousand southwestern tribesmen. He attacked Liulibao in southern Yunnan but failed against local defenders and fled to Burma. Many Sichuan-Yunnan soldiers and civilians still favored old Shu and shielded him, exhausting imperial troops. Upon hearing this, the emperor sent Duke Wucheng Zeng south from Chongqing for a second southwest inspection. In following years Yunnan remained under martial law with repeated purge-killings; native chieftaincies withered and the wilds fell silent.
english.flavorUSM.9.f: ...All my life I never sold my dragon-slaying skill...\n- Lu You
english.flavorUSM.9.1: Countrymen, I can no longer hear your voices. Is this victory?
english.flavorUSM.10.d: In 1850, Shu, Huai, and Chu rebelled - called in national history the 'Western Office Turmoil.' The two northwestern feudatories favored revolutionary politics influenced by French radicals. Huai differed: from usurper Zhi Jingyin down to ministers like Yang Xiuqing and Xiao Chaogui, their coalition centered on sectarian land networks, bearing the Lotus banner and Christian crosses. In essence this became the only major modern rebellion of White Lotus heterodox sectarian movements.\n\nWhite Lotus sects had cultivated Guizhou and Guangxi for a century. Did not chaos respond by the millions? After land reform under the national dynasty, Guangxi gentry entered even deeper. Thus, after Duke Zhongzheng Naosuke broke Huai prefectures, he launched a three-month purge of sect members: one convert found, whole family exterminated. Even meritorious old Ming houses were not spared. Harsh in form, but medicine for the state.
english.flavorUSM.10.f: ...In the seventh month, letters came from Nanjing bearing the chief minister's seal...\n- Chronicle of Southwestern Rectification Decrees
english.flavorUSM.10.1: Where did my own seal go? Ah, so it is with His Majesty...

english.ce_usm_conflicts_within_reason: Ming’s Zhu dynasty, or Wu’s Zheng house? For those able to take part in Southern Chinese politics, the question demands an answer at every moment. From village lecture halls on Sichuan’s frontier to the chamber of the Ministry of Rites in Nanjing, arguments, memorials, essays and reports call out to the public. There are more questions than answers, more quarrels than considered debate.

english.ce_usm_ruling_of_nanfu_reason: The Wu princely house, descended from Yongle-era admiral Zheng He, may long since have forgotten that its ancestors were nearly consumed by old eunuch abuses. Yet alliance with southern civic republicans has forged one of the world's most efficient and clean bureaucratic systems, while two centuries of autocratic reform ensured all institutions and controllers remain, to varying degrees, loyal to Prince Wu and his political bloc. Compared with inland feudatories struggling to govern even parts of China, the Zheng elites of Southern Wu direct the whole world in orderly fashion - and have done so for nearly a century.

english.is_opposition_usm.tt: Can participate in the Southern Ming Civil War
english.ce_usm_civilwar_journal_reason: The Zheng house of Hangzhou commands overwhelming prestige in old provinces of Min, Wu, Yue, Ning, and Miao, with a million soldiers under Southern Office banners. It also led reform and resistance against the Northern Court. By all right it can compel abdication from the weak Zhu throne to found a world empire and reunify Huaxia. Yet elsewhere in Southern Ming - especially the western inland influenced by Zhu Banbo and republican radicals - even people no longer loyal to Ming banner despise Hangzhou's 'examination-gentry parliamentarism.' In such turbulence, ambitious and unworthy opportunists will rebel against our great project of restoring order and renewing the age. Of course, should they lack courage, would the generous Supreme of Great Wu begrudge them marquisates?

english.ce_usm_suppress_rebellion: Second Jingnan War: Crush the Rebels
english.ce_usm_suppress_rebellion_reason: Remnants of the Western Office tore apart the realm merely because Zhu rule decayed and died, opening opportunities for Northern autocrats and western barbarians. They are criminals against China's progressive tomorrow. To continue economic construction and deepen land reform, we must quell rebellion by force and disarm old nobles and warlord adventurers completely.
english.ce_usm_restoration_of_ming: Second Jingnan War: Overthrow Wu, Restore Ming
english.ce_usm_restoration_of_ming_reason: Southern Office Wu are no more than Wa-blood usurpers, yet dare commit great treason akin to Southern Dynasties usurpations. They treat Ming as another Eastern Jin or Southern Tang while imposing extractive land-plunder rule and abusing pillars of state. Since antiquity, those who usurp by treason are enemies of China and may be slain by all. We are loyal ministers of Ming. Follow Taizong Yongle's example: obey Heaven's mandate, pacify national calamity!
english.ce_usm_acheive_revolution_reason: The Napoleonic clique of Southern Office Zheng are wolves at heart. At the critical moment they betrayed former leader Chen Dongyang's ideal and now seek to suppress our just movement for freedom and unification. They and the Zhu landlord bloc they discarded belong in history's grave!
english.ce_usm_cw_japanese_interest: Second Jingnan War: Wa Independence Movement
english.ce_usm_cw_japanese_interest_reason: The Zheng foothold in Kyushu forms part of Wu’s maritime power and has long affected the interests of Japan’s great houses. With civil war threatening the Southern realm, rival envoys cross the sea seeking ships and supplies. The government has an opportunity to recover the Wu-held lands of Kyushu and reshape relations across the strait.

english.usm_civilwar.1.d: The Zheng family has demanded a new dynasty and recognition from the provinces and overseas states. Hangzhou’s military and fiscal power gives force to its claim, but the centuries-old Zhu succession still commands loyalty. The dispute unresolved in the Assembly of Rites and cabinet has now reached the provinces.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must answer. Recognition accepts Zheng government under the new constitution; taking up arms for Ming requires allies and preparations against Hangzhou’s forces. Others would use the crisis to leave the existing hierarchy and govern independently.
english.usm_civilwar.1.f: Win hearts, then unify all under Heaven.\n- Popular Romance of the Three Kingdoms
english.usm_civilwar.1.1: Uphold Ming and rally the provinces!
english.usm_civilwar.1.3: Petition for accession and recognise Wu.
english.usm_civilwar_participate: This will lead you into war with Great Wu
english.usm_civilwar.2.d: Proclamations against the succession have spread. Wu is assembling the central army to enforce recognition of Zheng rule; Ming loyalist provinces are gathering troops and supplies for common resistance. The Southern and Western Administrations, once united against the North, now face one another in arms.\n\nMaritime and river trade routes will carry armies and suffer the disruption of war. Overseas dependencies, neighbouring states and distant merchants must choose their course anew. Whoever wins will inherit the demands of those who shed blood for victory.
english.usm_civilwar.2.d1:
The Southern Ming turmoil that began with Wu-Ming dynastic transfer reached an unprecedented peak on [Date.GetString|v].

Former Ming loyalists, landlords sacrificed in land reform, and remnants of the early-century civic revolution - three groups with very different aims - united under pressure from the Zheng house of Southern Office. Zhu Jiangchen and Feng Yunshan of Chu, Wei Jian and Xiao Huli of Shu, Zhu Jingyin and Yang Xiuqing of Huai raised arms under the banner 'Overthrow Wu, restore Ming, pacify national calamity by Heaven's mandate.' Emperor Tianyan sent Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, Lin Zexu, and Wu (Ii) Naosuke to suppress them.

When Tianyan took the throne, Southern Ming was nominally the world's leading empire. This upheaval shocked the world at once; from Far East Continent to distant England, states sent envoys. Today those envoys will witness a fierce eastern conflagration rekindled less than half a century after peace.
english.usm_civilwar.2.d2:

Former Ming loyalists, landlords sacrificed in land reform, and remnants of the early-century civic revolution - three groups with very different aims - united under pressure from the Zheng house of Southern Office. Zhu Jiangchen and Feng Yunshan of Chu, Wei Jian and Xiao Huli of Shu, Zhu Jingyin and Yang Xiuqing of Huai raised arms under the banner 'Overthrow Wu, restore Ming, pacify national calamity by Heaven's mandate.'
