The effect on the Standard of Living of Western Regions Han-Qiang Pops.
english.modifier_country_nesnd_qe1_conversion_co: The effect on the Cultural Acceptance of Western Regions Han-Qiang Pops.
english.modifier_country_fervor_target_nesnd_qe1: The effect on the Cultural Fervor of Western Regions Han-Qiang Pops.
english.nesnd_qe1_military_budget_button_desc: Provide supplies and funds for the expansion of the army.
english.nesnd_qe1_sol_loyalty_tt: For ten years, improving living standards have a 15% greater effect on Loyalist growth.
english.nesnd_qe1_sol_radical_tt: For ten years, falling living standards have a 10% greater effect on Radical growth.
english.nesnd_south_politics_summary:
#bold The Ming Court and Hangzhou#!
Finances and administration #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_finance').GetValue|1]/20#!　Cooperation in government #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_domestic').GetValue|1]/20#!
Zhu succession #v 20#!　Wu military strength #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_military').GetValue|1]/20#!
#bold Commitments#!　Ming #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_ming_accord').GetValue|1]%#!　Wu #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_wu_accord').GetValue|1]%#!
Continuous fulfilment #v [GetGlobalVariable('nesnd_south_peace_months').GetValue|0]/12#! months.

$nesnd_south_compact_detail_tt$
english.nesnd_south_offer_accord_desc: Appointments, taxation and military funding require a constitution that the Southern realm can uphold. Send our proposed settlement to the provinces and overseas states to seek their support.
english.nesnd_south_offer_available_tt: The court supports Ming or Wu, the crisis has not reached open conflict, and the country is neither at war nor in [concept_default]. Six months have passed since the last mission, and an eligible state can respond.
english.nesnd_south_accord_offer_tt: Send the proposed settlement to eligible provinces and states for their acceptance or refusal. Another mission may be sent after #v 6 months#!. Negotiations increase government wages by #n 3%#! and use #n 25#! [concept_authority].
english.nesnd_south_accord_accept_tt: Support the proposed settlement for #v 36 months#!, with alignment fixed for #v 6 months#!. Changing alignment, fighting the Southern central government, joining another overlord or expiry ends the commitment. Wu integration terms cede our Chinese territories; Japanese terms cede our holdings in Shikoku and Kyushu while retaining other lands. Relations with the centre improve by #p 15#!.
english.nesnd_south_leave_accord_desc: Withdraw our consent to the settlement and reconsider our relationship with the Southern central government.
english.nesnd_south_accord_leave_tt: Withdraw the commitment and any unfulfilled consent to integration or cession. Relations with the centre fall by #n 15#!; alignment cannot change for #v 6 months#!.
english.nesnd_south_retry_confrontation_desc: The previous negotiations failed, and opponents of the new dynasty still command their own territory and troops. Reopen the confrontation and demand an answer concerning the central government’s authority.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.ming: The cabinet’s envoy has arrived in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to seek our support for a settlement preserving the Ming dynasty. A constitution will define the powers of the centre and provinces. The Zhu sovereign will remain at the head of government, the cabinet and Six Ministries will administer under law, and provincial delegates will participate through the Assembly of Rites.\n\nAcceptance commits our government to the Zhu succession and this settlement. We retain our government, territory and existing laws. The status and commerce of overseas states will continue to be governed by their separate treaties.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.integration: The Southern Administration’s envoy offers clear terms: recognise Zheng accession and place our Chinese territories under direct central administration as provinces. Their separate military and political authority will end; appointments, taxation and military funding will fall under the new dynasty’s constitution and the cabinet and Six Ministries.\n\nThis would complete the centralising reforms long pursued by Hangzhou. Accepting means deciding who will govern and tax these lands. If our country also holds territory overseas, its government and boundaries there will be retained.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.japan: The Southern Administration asks us to recognise the Zheng succession and surrender any territory we hold in Shikoku and Kyushu to direct Wu rule. Our government would retain its remaining lands.\n\nThe proposal ties a Southern dynastic succession to Japan’s borders. Acceptance would secure our place in the new order, at the cost of those territories. The court and the great houses must weigh that price before answering Hangzhou.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.overseas: The Southern Administration asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to recognise the Zheng succession while retaining our government, territory and existing status. The Assembly of Rites and cabinet will settle the Southern constitution’s distribution of sovereign and provincial powers. Our commerce, ports and military obligations will remain matters for separate treaties.\n\nThe Zheng family needs recognition at home and overseas. Before answering, we must consider the place this succession would leave for our country.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.a: Support the settlement and recognise the succession.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.b: Accept provincial integration under the central government.
english.nesnd_south_accords.1.c: Recognise the succession and accept the territorial cession.
english.nesnd_south_accords.20.d: For a year, the provinces and states supporting Ming have upheld their commitment to reform. The provisions debated by provincial delegates in the Assembly of Rites on appointments, land taxes and military funding now have a basis for enactment. The cabinet asks [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] to proclaim a constitution defining the powers of the centre and provinces.\n\nSince Chen Dongyang restored provincial administrative commissions, the Southern government has coordinated civil and military affairs, but the titles of former feudal lords still sustain local influence. Disputes set aside during resistance to the North can at last be settled in the assembly. The Zhu succession will endure, with sovereign, cabinet and provinces each exercising authority under the constitution.
english.nesnd_south_accords.21.d: The parties supporting Zheng have sustained their commitment to reform for a year. States due for provincial integration have accepted the transfer of their Chinese territories, and the Japanese governments have accepted the terms concerning Shikoku and Kyushu. Hangzhou’s military and fiscal power now has a basis for establishing the new order.\n\nThe Assembly of Rites and cabinet will incorporate appointments, taxation, military funding and provincial government into a new constitution defining the powers of monarch and assembly. If the Zheng family accepts the throne, it must also accept these obligations. The Southern Administration, long governing in Ming’s name, will face the world under its own dynasty.
english.nesnd_south_accords.21.a: Accept the throne and govern under the constitution.
english.nesnd_south_accords.reconsider: Defer the settlement and reopen deliberations.
english.nesnd_south_ming_peace_result_tt: Preserve the Zhu sovereign and Ming state. Members retain their territories, governments and economic laws. The centre accepts constitutional obligations for #v 10 years#!. States honouring their commitments receive temporary prestige benefits, with an additional reward for sufficient preparations.
english.nesnd_south_wu_peace_result_tt: Establish Wu and integrate only eligible Chinese territories with explicit consent and local control. Overseas countries and overseas lands remain separate. Japan cedes only its own Shikoku and Kyushu territories. A player who explicitly accepted whole-country integration takes control of Wu only if no other human controls it. New provinces face #v 12 months#! of transition costs.
english.nesnd_south_accords.22.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has proclaimed the revised constitution. Provincial delegates participate in the Assembly of Rites; the cabinet and Six Ministries conduct central government; provincial administrative commissions administer local affairs under the settlement. The Zhu house has gained room to govern beyond Hangzhou’s domination, while accepting constitutional limits on the sovereign.\n\nThe settlement preserves Southern Ming’s Confucian form of constitutional democracy and federation. Its provinces and overseas states retain their governments and territories, and the centre assumes the expense of maintaining the new institutions. Powers once contested by the Southern and Western Administrations through military strength now have an agreed constitutional basis.
english.nesnd_south_accords.23.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has taken the throne and proclaimed the Wu constitution. The centre has assumed administration of the Chinese territories that accepted integration, together with the lands ceded in Shikoku and Kyushu. Overseas states retaining their territories continue to govern themselves and deal with the new dynasty under their existing treaties.\n\nThe constitution recognises both the deliberative powers of the Assembly of Rites and the sovereign authority of the Zheng monarch, with the cabinet and Six Ministries conducting government accordingly. Generations of military power, commerce and overseas expansion since Zheng Zhao have at last become an empire ruled in the Zheng family’s own name.
english.nesnd_south_ready_unknown: National preparedness has not yet been assessed.
english.nesnd_south_ready_known: Preparations #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_total').GetValue|1]/100#! (finances [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_finance').GetValue|1]/20, military [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_military').GetValue|1]/35, inputs [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_supply').GetValue|0]/25, government [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_domestic').GetValue|1]/20)\nCrew #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_actual_crew').GetValue|D]#!; crew-ready ships #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_ships_ready').GetValue|0]/[Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_ships').GetValue|0]#!; naval projection #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_ready_naval_projection').GetValue|1]#!.
english.nesnd_chen_case_concluded_tt: The attempt on Chen has been resolved, or he has left this country. If he has been fatally injured, his death must be confirmed before the succession can proceed.
english.nesnd_supply_status_jobs_hna: #n Garrisons and academies are understaffed.#! Xiangfan needs recruits, and its academies need teachers to prepare students for political life.\n$nesnd_supply_rules_link$
english.nesnd_supply_status_jobs_sih: #n Sichuan’s workshops lack workers.#! The tooling industry and its iron or timber suppliers cannot yet maintain production.\n$nesnd_supply_rules_link$
english.nesnd_supply_status_jobs_gng: #n Logging camps and paper mills lack workers.#! Guangxi must put these establishments into regular operation.\n$nesnd_supply_rules_link$
english.nesnd_supply_status_jobs_hus: #n Ports and offices lack personnel.#! The republic needs both cargo handlers and staffed administrations.\n$nesnd_supply_rules_link$
english.nesnd_south_peace_stability_tt: Succession Pressure is below #v 60#!, and the country has recovered from [concept_bankruptcy].
english.nesnd_south_ming_supply_tt: Paper, Tools and Small Arms cost no more than #v 50%#! above their base prices in the central market, and none is locally scarce in our country. Supplies from our shared market count toward this requirement.
english.nesnd_south_peace_b1_note: A peaceful settlement requires Succession Pressure below #v 60#! and recovery from [concept_bankruptcy]. Ming also needs adequate market supplies of Paper, Tools and Small Arms.
english.character_role_nesnd_ming_refuge_desc: A surviving member of the Ming dynasty during the southern succession.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_reason: Chen Dongyang’s reforms have carried the Southern provinces beyond the military fiefs of the old Northern Ming order. Yet a deliberation in the assembly cannot by itself dissolve the grievances between the Southern and Western Administrations. With the parties supporting the same settlement, the centre must meet the agreed administrative expenses and put its proposed distribution of powers into practice.\n\nOverseas states also await fulfilment of the court’s commitments. Sustaining these arrangements month by month may bring the succession dispute back within reach of negotiation.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_status: Months implementing the settlement: #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_south_reconciliation_payments').GetValue|0]#!. Succession Pressure: #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_south_pressure_value')|1] / 100#!. While active: [concept_budget_government_wages] #n +5%#!, [concept_authority] #n −50#!. Implementation ends at #v 40#! pressure.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_start_desc: Meet the administrative costs of reform, coordinate the centre and provinces, and fulfil commitments to overseas states.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_stop_desc: Stop the additional administrative expenditure for the settlement, ending this effort to ease the court dispute.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_requirements: Meet every other peace requirement for the chosen Ming or Wu route, with no southern [concept_diplomatic_play] or war and no [concept_bankruptcy] recovery penalty.
english.nesnd_south_reconciliation_effect_tt: Maintain additional [concept_budget_government_wages] of #n +5%#! and use #n 50#! [concept_authority]. After #v 1 month#!, each month in which the chosen side’s political, financial and commitment conditions hold reduces succession pressure by #p 3#!. Sending proposals or renewing commitments does not itself reduce pressure. Implementation stops if conditions cease to hold, and ends once pressure reaches #v 40#!. A formal peaceful settlement still requires #v 12 months#! of continuous fulfilment.
english.nesnd_ming_receive_court_tt: If legitimate Ming royals have taken refuge here, supporting Ming enthrones the surviving emperor or heir while retaining the local leader. With no living legitimate successor, a regency remains.
english.nesnd_court_followup.15.d: After the succession, the Zhu relatives remaining in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] still need homes and support. Providing for the former imperial family preserves their status and shows their old followers how the new government treats its predecessors. The people and obligations left by centuries of imperial rule cannot vanish with a change of dynasty.
english.nesnd_court_followup.19.d: The succession dispute has lasted two years without a settlement acceptable to all parties. The Southern provinces and overseas states continue to exercise their existing powers, while the divide between Ming and Wu has not produced a common war.\n\nWe can close these constitutional negotiations and accept the present borders, governments and treaty relations. Neither side will have fulfilled its programme of reform, but the realm need no longer wait for a constitution that remains beyond agreement.
english.nesnd_court_followup.19.a: Accept the present settlement and let the people recover.
english.nesnd_south_inconclusive_order_desc: After two years without a new constitution or a Jingnan confrontation, accept the existing borders, governments and treaty relations and close the succession negotiations.
english.nesnd_south_inconclusive_result_tt: End the Ming–Wu crisis on the basis of current territory, governments and treaties. No subjects are annexed, and neither side receives victory rewards.
english.character_role_nesnd_ming_patron_desc: A former local ruler supporting the provisional Ming court.
english.nesnd_american_restoration_reason: The heirs of Moctezuma and the Andean court claim different inheritances. Both confront a question the republics have left unresolved: can Indigenous communities control their land and local government? Dynastic supporters appeal to old compacts, while rural communities resist dispossession. Recognition, negotiation, and repression offer sharply different futures.
english.nesnd_native_recognize: Recognize the Dynasty and Local Compacts
english.nesnd_native_recognize_desc: Bring the old dynasty and local communities into a new political settlement.
english.nesnd_native_recognize_tt: Restore an Indigenous monarchy. If an Inca court already exists, propose a union requiring its consent within ninety days.
english.nesnd_native_negotiate_desc: Seek rural cooperation through local councils and negotiations over land.
english.nesnd_native_negotiate_tt: Reduce restoration pressure by fifteen points. Local councils continue to ease pressure during the negotiations.
english.nesnd_native_suppress_desc: Use the army against the restoration movement, accepting displacement and rural radicalization.
english.nesnd_native_suppress_tt: Forty percent of each existing Indigenous population will migrate to a refuge with a suitable receiving state. Those with no available destination remain where they are. Receiving states gain 25% Migration Attraction for 60 months. Some political figures will go into exile; after migration, 15% of the remaining Indigenous population in our country becomes Radical.
english.nesnd_restoration_pressure_bar_desc: The growing alliance between rural communities and dynastic supporters. At its peak, restorationists attempt an uprising where sufficient territory and population are available.
english.nesnd_restoration_existing_court_status: The Inca court has been established. When both countries are independent and at peace, we may propose a union, subject to the other government's agreement.
english.nesnd_restoration_waiting_land_status: Restorationists seek a viable core. Territory, population, or current conflicts prevent a territorial uprising.
english.nesnd_restoration_politics_status: Dynastic supporters and local communities are gathering political support.
english.nesnd_native_restoration_war_reason: The restorationists have formed a government and demand that the central government surrender its authority. Community lands, the allegiance of the army and the dynasty's position are all at stake. Annexing the rival government would reunite the country; a negotiated peace would leave it divided.
english.nesnd_restoration_war_status: War and an actual settlement must decide the restoration's future.
english.dp_nesnd_native_restoration_desc: The restored dynasty and the republic contest rule over the country. The victor will annex the defeated state.
english.wg_nesnd_restoration_settlement_desc: Defeat the opposing government and annex its territory. Suppression first resolves Indigenous refuge and political exile.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.1.d: Supporters of the old dynasty have joined local armed groups to break with the central government and form a government of their own. Communities seek to defend their lands, while restorationists demand the dynasty's return. Both sides are mobilizing local support.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.2.d: Indigenous communities displaced by repression have crossed the border, bringing family ties, local organizations, and memories of lost homes. Their destinations will anchor new refuge networks, though arrival does not immediately restore their livelihoods.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.3.d: The army has dispersed the restoration movement, but the rural conflict persists. Families with a receiving destination begin to leave; those without one remain. Political representatives enter exile, while disputes over land and local authority endure.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.4.d: The old dynasty has returned to the center of political life. Local communities have offered their support in pursuit of recognition for their land and representatives. Relations among court, assembly, and countryside will now develop under the new settlement.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.5.d: The rival government has lost its last territory, and the country is reunited. The newly acquired provinces still bear the wounds of war. Disputed land and the fate of those driven into exile now require the government's attention.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.5.a: Take responsibility for the country left by war.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.6.d: The restoration dispute has subsided. The government has not achieved unification through this confrontation. It must reconsider its course in light of the present borders and the forces that now hold power.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.10.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_restoration_applicant').GetName] proposes recognizing the existing Inca court and joining our state. Union would end the partition and bring its local communities into the political settlement we must uphold.
english.nesnd_khanate_emergence_reason: The American Civil War has shaken authority on the Great Plains. Dongzhou's new registration law has stirred Indigenous resentment, and community leaders are rallying supporters of the earlier uprising to establish a khanate of their own.
english.nesnd_khanate_waiting_status: Awaiting four connected, populated American states on the Great Plains. The United States must retain populated territory after cession.
english.nesnd_khanate_established_tt: The Indigenous khanate has actually received four states and established its government.
english.nesnd_khanate_survival_reason: Both the United States and Dongzhou demand the khanate's territory. The new khan must lead its communities against both powers and defend the lands on which their people have settled.
english.nesnd_khanate_usa_status: The United States has not ended its intervention against the khanate.
english.nesnd_khanate_hus_status: Dongzhou has not ended its intervention against the khanate.
english.nesnd_khanate_survival_status: Both interventions against the khanate have ended.
english.nesnd_khanate_survived_tt: The khanate survives and both independent interventions have reached an outcome.
english.nesnd_suppress_native_khanate_reason: Territorial cession and migration have changed the balance of power in North America. Our government seeks to annex the khanate, while the khanate intends to force its interveners to acknowledge its position.
english.nesnd_khanate_intervention_status: Our government is seeking to annex the khanate.
english.nesnd_khanate_destroyed_tt: Our country has annexed the Great Plains Khanate.
english.nesnd_khanate_suppression_failed_tt: The intervention has ended without annexation of the khanate by our country.
english.nesnd_khanate_war: War of Intervention on the Plains
english.dp_nesnd_khanate_suppression: War of Intervention on the Plains
english.dp_nesnd_khanate_suppression_desc: The intervening power demands annexation of the Great Plains Khanate; the khanate demands the humiliation of its opponent.
english.wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_desc: Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation.
english.nesnd_native_american_republic_desc: Unite the Americas and Greenland. Once the former state has ceased to exist, establish a republic with Indigenous primary cultures and a complete ordinary legal settlement.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.2.d: Both interventions have ended, and the khanate has preserved its government. Communities united to resist outside powers must now settle questions of taxation, defence and local authority if the plains compact is to endure.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.2.a: Preserve the state we have built.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.3.d: From the northern plains to the southern mountains, the Americas now answer to one government. The old state of Dongzhou is gone. The new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has taken its name, abolished its social hierarchy and proclaimed republican government across the continent.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.3.a: Let the peoples of America shape their future.
english.nesnd_a2_exodus_both_desc: Manchu and Mongol communities have left for [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_a2_cne_country').GetName] or the west of [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_a2_usa_country').GetName]. Each community has a seventy percent chance of choosing the former and thirty percent the latter. Community sizes differ, so the actual population is not divided in an exact seventy-to-thirty ratio.
english.nesnd_a2_exodus_cne_desc: No receiving destination remains in the American west. The Manchu and Mongol communities have all moved to [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_a2_cne_country').GetName], and the planned division between two destinations has not taken place.
english.nesnd_a2_exodus_usa_desc: No receiving destination remains in the east. The Manchu and Mongol communities have all moved to western [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_a2_usa_country').GetName], and the planned division between two destinations has not taken place.
english.nesnd_a2_exodus_none_desc: Neither destination can receive the Manchu and Mongol communities. They remain where they live, and this migration has ended. The registration choice already enacted remains in force.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.11.d: The Inca court did not consent to union within the allotted time. Both states retain their governments and territory. Negotiations may be renewed after the waiting period.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.12.d: The Inca court has declined the union offer. A shared dynastic tradition has not proved sufficient to end the partition. Talks may resume after the waiting period.
english.nesnd_restore_native_hus_desc: Unite the Americas and Greenland. Once the former state has ceased to exist, establish a republic with Indigenous primary cultures and a complete ordinary legal settlement.
english.nesnd_native_americas_unified_tt: Own every region in the Americas and Greenland in full, including uncolonized land and foreign portions of split states.
english.nesnd_native_hus_restored_tt: Adopt Indigenous primary cultures, establish a republic, and enact the complete settlement of twenty-four ordinary law groups.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.13.d: Dynastic supporters have reconvened the local communities to settle relations among court, local representatives, and countryside. The existing state will continue under a renewed political compact, bearing the divisions left by the earlier war.
english.nesnd_american_restoration.13.a: Preserve the state and renew its compact.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.2.both: Both intervening governments have been forced to accept humiliation, and the khanate retains its government. Victory has lent prestige to the Plains compact. Its communities must now turn their wartime alliance into lasting government.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.2.one: One intervention ended with the opponent's humiliation, and the other has also come to a close. The khanate has preserved its government. The plains communities must now carry their wartime cooperation into everyday rule.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.2.none: Both interventions have ended. Though it has forced neither opponent to accept humiliation, the khanate has preserved its government. Its communities must share the burdens of taxation and defence to sustain the new state.
english.war_goal_wg_nesnd_restoration_settlement: Defeat the opposing government and annex its territory. Suppression first resolves Indigenous refuge and political exile.
Defeat the opposing government and annex its territory. Suppression first resolves Indigenous refuge and political exile.
Defeat the opposing government and annex its territory. Suppression first resolves Indigenous refuge and political exile.
english.war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_ty: Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation.
english.war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_de: Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation.
english.war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_sw: Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.4.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_khanate_opponent').GetName] has withdrawn from treaties with the khanate containing an alliance or defensive pact, clearing the way for intervention. Any trade or other provisions in the same treaties end with them. The withdrawing country bears the diplomatic cost of breaking its word. Neither country's treaties with third powers are included.
english.nesnd_native_khanate.4.a: The war begins with a broken promise.
english.nesnd_final_native_restored_existing_tt: Restored rule: Prestige +30, Rural Folk Approval +3, Construction Efficiency +10%; lasts 120 months.
english.nesnd_egypt_independence_reason: The agreement of 1825 recognized Egypt's independence from Ottoman rule. Six powers guaranteed that independence in exchange for investment rights along the Nile. The government gained a respite, but its workshops, schools and army grew dependent on foreign money and expertise.\n\nAn investment partner can provide machinery, teachers and new industries. As foreign ownership grows, Egypt has less room to act on its own. Over the next thirty years, the government must weigh development against independence.
english.nesnd_egypt_with_investor_status: Current partner: [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_egypt_investor').GetCountry.GetName]. Foreign share of the economy: [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_egypt_foreign_share')|%1].
english.nesnd_egypt_without_investor_status: No single power holds Egypt’s investment commitment. Foreign share of the economy: [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_egypt_foreign_share')|%1].
english.nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts: Schools and Workshops on the Nile
english.nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts_reason: Egypt needs people who can build, repair and operate machinery. Graduates need workshops in which to practise their skills, and toolmakers need workers able to use their products. The government hopes foreign investment will establish industries that can eventually train and employ their own specialists.
english.nesnd_egypt_generation_passed: The independence settlement has endured for thirty years
english.nesnd_egypt_dependence_result: When Independence is exhausted, Egypt will accept protection from an eligible investment partner. If no partner can provide protection, or the arrangement cannot be established, the government will bear the political consequences.
english.nesnd_egypt_investor_desc: Choose a principal investment partner to secure lasting support for construction, education and industry.
english.nesnd_egypt_choose_cost: A valid investment commitment costs 1 Independence each month. Changing partners does not reset Independence or the thirty-year term.
english.nesnd_egypt_investor_none_desc: Egypt will bear political responsibility for its own development.
english.nesnd_egypt_none_effect: Withdraw the investment commitment and its benefits. Existing foreign ownership still affects Independence.
english.nesnd_egypt_protectorate_desc: Egypt retains its government and external diplomacy under the obligations of a protectorate settlement.
english.nesnd_egypt_protectorate_pact_desc: Egypt accepts the protection of its investment partner.
english.nesnd_egypt.1.d: For thirty years, Egypt has preserved its own government and control of its foreign affairs. Foreign merchants still operate along the Nile, and the powers still pursue their interests here, but they have not gained the right to decide Egypt's affairs. Our schools and workshops will continue to sustain that independence.
english.nesnd_egypt.1.a: Let the next generation inherit it.
english.nesnd_egypt.2.d: Egypt has accepted its investment partner's protection. The foreign power that supported our workshops, army and schools now has a say in the country's affairs. Our government will continue to administer Egypt, but its foreign policy must respect the protectorate agreement.
english.nesnd_egypt.3.d: The government can no longer sustain the independence settlement, yet no investment partner can provide protection. Foreign industries and assets remain, but the guarantees have failed. Those in power must now face discontent at home and pressure from abroad without that support.
english.nesnd_egypt.3.a: The government must answer for this.
english.nesnd_egypt.4.d: Graduates are entering the workshops, and toolmakers and new industries have established a steady workforce. Egypt is developing its own capacity to teach and manufacture, with more local engineers and workers able to take part in its development.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomatic_cooldown: Six months have passed since the last proposal
english.nesnd_canon_no_french_alliance_tt: The prospective partner is not allied to France
english.nesnd_canon_request_1_desc: Seek a military alliance with a German state to share the risks of continental rivalry.
english.nesnd_canon_request_11_desc: Offer mutual defence to a German state without committing it to an offensive alliance.
english.nesnd_canon_request_2_desc: Open the federation to European investment in support of industry and continental armaments.
english.nesnd_canon_request_3_desc: Seek French political credit for the country’s Italian programme.
english.nesnd_canon_request_4_desc: Protect an Italian state through a defensive agreement and establish a basis for intervention.
english.nesnd_canon_request_5_desc: Seek an investment partner to support the country’s economic development.
english.nesnd_canon_request_sent_tt: Send the proposal and await a reply. It remains open for at most 45 days; another proposal cannot be sent for six months.
english.nesnd_canon_accept_request_tt: Accept the undertaking set out in the proposal.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.d: A diplomatic proposal has reached the government. The envoy awaits an answer.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.alliance: [SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName] proposes a military alliance with a five-year binding period. Its envoy links the security of the German states to the continental order dominated by France and asks us to share the risks of diplomacy and war.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.defense: [SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName] proposes a defensive pact with a five-year binding period. It seeks a practical safeguard for national independence and expects both governments to fulfil their obligations if either is attacked.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.credit: [SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName] asks France to lend political credit to its Italian programme for six years. Its supporters hope French prestige will persuade domestic and foreign interests to accept the undertaking. The commitment itself does not alter the sovereignty of the Italian states.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.investment: [SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName] offers our investors access under an agreement with a five-year binding period. It hopes to attract factories and expertise while accepting the disputes over income and influence that foreign capital can bring. The agreement grants investment rights; construction remains a business decision.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.t: The Envoy Returns with an Agreement
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.d: The other government has accepted the terms, and the agreed undertaking is now in place. Further cooperation will depend on both countries continuing to fulfil their obligations.
english.nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.d: These negotiations have produced no effective agreement. The other government either withheld its commitment or circumstances changed before the original terms could be settled. The envoy will return with that outcome.
english.nesnd_prussian_coalition_reason: France and the Confederation of the Rhine sustain the division of the German states. To challenge their influence, Prussia must convince other governments that Berlin will commit its army to their common interests.\n\nAlliances and defensive pacts can bring the states together, but troops and armaments must sustain those commitments. Governments still bound to France or a Rhenish overlord need freedom in foreign affairs before they can join.
english.nesnd_prussian_coalition_status: Secure alliances or defensive pacts with three distinct German states and establish the necessary army and armaments capacity.
english.nesnd_prussian_subordinate_status: Our subject relationship restricts independent diplomacy.
english.nesnd_prussian_rhine: The Contest over the Rhenish Order
english.nesnd_prussian_rhine_reason: Common defence has brought the armies of the German states into cooperation with Prussia. Staff officers in Berlin are coordinating their preparations, confronting France and the Confederation of the Rhine with a stronger force. Shared military commitments are giving Prussia a greater voice in German affairs.
english.nesnd_prussian_rhine_resolved_tt: Prussia’s state has formed Germany, or France no longer rules German subjects and the Rhenish Confederation is independent
english.nesnd_prussian_rhine_cooperating: Shared military capacity and agreements continue to support the Rhenish policy.
english.nesnd_prussian_rhine_paused: Insufficient pacts or military capacity have suspended joint staff cooperation.
english.nesnd_austrian_italy_reason: Republicans supported by France, the ruling dynasties and the Pope all seek to shape Italy's future. Austria can support independent states through defensive pacts or intervene to prevent their annexation.\n\nIntervention requires money and allies. Accepting the advance of a unifying power would mean accepting a diminished Austrian influence in Italy.
english.nesnd_austrian_waiting_status: No Italian territorial dispute is currently available for Austrian intervention.
english.nesnd_austrian_committed_status: Austria has joined the defending side. The dispute remains unresolved.
english.nesnd_austria_intervene: Intervene to Protect the Italian State
english.nesnd_austria_intervene_desc: Commit Austria’s forces and prestige to the defence of the threatened state.
english.nesnd_austria_intervene_tt: Join the defending side in the current Italian dispute. Victory, territorial loss and stalemate have different consequences for Austrian influence.
english.nesnd_austria_acknowledge: Accept This Change in the Balance
english.nesnd_austria_acknowledge_desc: Decline to use Austrian arms against the current territorial or unification demand.
english.nesnd_austria_acknowledge_tt: Decline intervention in this dispute. Another intervention cannot be proposed for 24 months.
english.nesnd_austrian_cooldown_tt: Twenty-four months have passed since the previous intervention decision
english.nesnd_austrian_current_dispute_tt: An Italian territorial dispute is in the diplomatic negotiation phase
english.nesnd_usa_continental_reason: Federal expansionists call themselves the protectors of white America and demand the western territories of $HUS$. Settlers seek land, while business interests look to European capital to finance railways and armaments. Their allies in Congress are seeking the funds to force concessions from $HUS$.
english.nesnd_usa_no_border_status: No eligible $HUS$ territory currently borders the federation.
english.nesnd_usa_civil_war_status: Civil war has suspended new frontier offensives. Economic development and existing diplomatic undertakings continue.
english.nesnd_usa_war_status: The Union is pressing its demand for the disputed frontier territory.
english.nesnd_usa_european_treaty_tt: An effective European investment agreement is in force
english.nesnd_usa_claim_cooldown_tt: Six months have passed since the last frontier claim
english.nesnd_usa_border_cooldown_tt: Twenty-four months have passed since the last frontier dispute ended
english.nesnd_usa_civil_war_pause_tt: The federation is not fighting a civil war
english.nesnd_usa_no_pending_war_tt: No frontier demand or war remains unresolved
english.nesnd_usa_next_border_desc: Select a $HUS$-held frontier state for consideration.
english.nesnd_usa_next_border_tt: Select an eligible neighbouring state without changing ownership of any territory.
english.nesnd_usa_claim_border_desc: Direct the federation’s frontier policy toward the selected land.
english.nesnd_usa_claim_border_tt: Gain a claim on the selected state and lose 10 relations with $HUS$. Another claim cannot be asserted for six months.
english.nesnd_usa_press_west_desc: Present a formal demand backed by the claim, leaving the other government to concede or resist.
english.nesnd_usa_press_west_tt: Start a Return State diplomatic play against $HUS$ for the selected state. Truces and existing agreements still apply. The first successful acquisition of the requested land grants a five-year military benefit.
english.nesnd_europe_america.1.d: Three German states have concluded pacts with us, and our troops and armaments can sustain their common defence. Their staffs can now coordinate military preparations against France and its allies.
english.nesnd_europe_america.1.a: Let the staffs begin their work.
english.nesnd_europe_america.2.d: The old order through which France dominated the German states has receded. Prussia has gained influence in the struggle, and the military and diplomatic ties forged along the way will continue to shape the states' decisions.
english.nesnd_europe_america.2.a: A new standing brings new responsibilities.
english.nesnd_europe_america.3.d: Austria has joined the defending side in the Italian dispute. Diplomatic assurances now carry military and financial commitments, and Vienna’s prestige will share in the outcome.
english.nesnd_europe_america.4.d: Our opponent has accepted the war demands, and the Italian state under our protection has preserved its position. Austria has fulfilled its commitment to defend it, strengthening Vienna's standing among the states.
english.nesnd_europe_america.4.a: Let the states remember our commitment.
english.nesnd_europe_america.5.t: Intervention Fails to Preserve the Balance
english.nesnd_europe_america.5.d: Austria’s intervention has failed to preserve the position it sought to defend. Territorial demands, subordination or the disappearance of the protected state have undone the original commitment. Vienna must face the consequences in Italy.
english.nesnd_europe_america.6.d: The dispute has ended without a result Austria can claim as a victory. The protected state survives, but the disagreement has not been decisively settled. Both sides must consider their next course.
english.nesnd_europe_america.6.a: Let the troops return for now.
english.nesnd_europe_america.7.d: The federation has acquired the $HUS$ territory demanded in this dispute. Its frontier claim has changed the actual border, bringing new prestige to the army and the commercial interests supporting expansion.
english.nesnd_europe_america.7.a: Govern the land we have acquired.
english.nesnd_europe_america.8.d: The Union has failed to obtain all the territory it demanded. The dispute is over, and the government has suspended further advances for now. Supporters of expansion are already looking for another opportunity.
english.nesnd_europe_america.10.d: The United States has demanded [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_usa_disputed_state').GetName]. Federal envoys call it the restoration of a rightful border; residents, landowners and the garrison face an immediate contest over sovereignty. Our government must decide its response through the diplomatic play now before it.
english.nesnd_europe_america.10.a: The frontier is not unclaimed land.
english.subject_type_nesnd_egypt_protectorate_de: Egypt retains its government while accepting obligations to its protector under the settlement.
english.nesnd_prussian_staff_term_tt: Joint staff cooperation lasts for at most ten years. It requires continuing alliances or defensive pacts with three distinct German partners and the stated military capacity; benefits pause if those conditions lapse.
english.nesnd_egypt_protectorate_action_notifica: The protectorate agreement has ended. Both countries are released from the obligations of that relationship.
english.nesnd_egypt.3.unworkable: Our investment partner remains, but the protectorate agreement could not be established. The government sought support at home on the strength of that guarantee. It must now face Egypt's difficulties without it.
english.nesnd_egypt.6.d: Egypt now answers to another overlord, bringing the former investment arrangement to an end. The new subject relationship will shape the government's authority at home and abroad.
english.nesnd_egypt_lost_investor_status: The former investment arrangement has lost its qualified sponsor. Foreign ownership of the economy: [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_egypt_foreign_share')|%1].
english.nesnd_final_canon_success_condition_tt: The requesting country receives the following support only if the commitment takes effect. Investment requires an actual investment-rights agreement; permission does not guarantee new factories. First-investment awards cannot be claimed again.
english.nesnd_final_french_credit_existing_tt: Once political credit takes effect: Influence +100 and Prestige +25 for 72 months.
english.nesnd_final_usa_capital_existing_tt: On the first successful investment agreement: Construction Efficiency +15%, Manufacturing Throughput +10%, Technology Spread +10% for 60 months.
english.nesnd_final_small_capital_existing_tt: On the first successful investment agreement: Construction Efficiency +10% and Technology Spread +10% for 60 months.
english.nesnd_crisis.30.local: Land commissioners in [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_land_petition_state').GetName] have surveyed the countryside under the new law, yet several local military estates still collect rent under the old rules. Farmers who have paid the redemption price are told by their old masters that their fields remain military property and that the dues must be paid. Teachers who helped draft their petitions have been arrested for concealing property.\n\nThe deeds submitted by the affected counties contradict the garrison registers. The provincial governor seeks authority to review the cases, while the commissioners ask the court to send troops to recover the withheld records. As the dispute drags on, farmers gather in the county towns, awaiting an answer from the government that promised to free them.
english.nesnd_federal_compact_button_alt_desc: Reform has carried the Southern realm beyond the old order of military fiefs, while Hangzhou still commands the troops and revenues needed to sustain it. The time has come for a new dynasty. We should first seek the consent of the provinces and overseas states, then bring appointments, taxation, military funding, provincial powers and the position of the Zhu house before the Assembly of Rites and cabinet. A constitution defining the powers of sovereign and assembly will lay the foundations of Zheng rule.
english.nesnd_south_reconsider_tt: Restart the #v 12-month#! period of continuous fulfilment.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d1: Our overlord has agreed to loosen its control, granting us a more autonomous status. The two governments have established a five-year truce.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d2: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] has recognized our independence. The subject relationship is dissolved, and a five-year truce now stands between us. Our government will conduct its own domestic and foreign affairs.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d3: Our overlord has given its assent to domestic reform. The government may pursue changes to public appointments, military administration and representation while the subject relationship remains in force.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d4: [SCOPE.sCountry('jp_partner').GetNameNoFormatting] has provided development funds. The grant will support construction and the training of skilled workers. Further funding of this kind will be unavailable for three years.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d5: The Korean settlement has been accepted. Our claims to Busan and Yangho have been withdrawn, and any territory we still held there has passed to Korea. Future relations across the strait will proceed within these borders.
english.nesnd_jp_foreign.2.d7: Our overlord has authorized negotiations for union with the other Japanese subjects. Our envoys may now approach them, though each invited government must still consent to the union.
english.nesnd_per.4.d_unavailable: The government has chosen expansion to the west, but the proposed tributary arrangement with Ili has not taken effect. Commanders and merchants can still pursue a western policy, drawing on the troops, revenues and support presently available.
english.nesnd_feedback_patron_crown_tt: Weaken the provincial literati and military in favour of the Crown. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the Crown falls below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
english.nesnd_feedback_patron_literati_tt: Weaken the Crown and military in favour of the provincial literati. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the literati fall below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
english.nesnd_feedback_patron_army_tt: Weaken the Crown and provincial literati in favour of the military. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the military falls below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
english.nesnd_feedback_patron_cancel_tt: Withdraw the current patronage and its modifiers, restoring the weight it had taken from the other two factions.
english.nesnd_feedback_coup_tt: End the current faction patronage. Another such change of government cannot be attempted for #v five years#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_law_push_tt: This proposal can be pressed again after #v six months#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_economy_push_tt: Move the balance of power #v 25#! points towards the Economic Faction. This proposal can be made again after #v six months#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_army_petition_tt: Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Military Faction. Frontier victories may be presented again after #v twelve months#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_economy_petition_tt: Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Economic Faction. Reform achievements may be presented again after #v twelve months#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_military_budget_tt: Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Military Faction. Further funding may be provided after #v six months#!.
english.nesnd_feedback_per_aid_tt: Commit to seeking Qin aid. Progress towards the Near-Western Empire’s future increases by #p 2#! each month. This choice is final.
english.nesnd_feedback_per_covert_tt: Commit to covert support for Qin’s provincial opponents. Progress increases by #p 2#! each month; while preparations continue, Western Qin loses #n 1#! Cultural Unity per month. This choice is final.
english.nesnd_feedback_per_maintenance_tt: Renewed monthly while these conditions hold; removed when they no longer do.
english.nesnd_cne_respite_button_desc: The court will suspend land, urban and military-estate reforms, giving the provinces time to restore livelihoods and settle disputes.
english.nesnd_cne_respite_unused_tt: We have not yet called a general pause during this land revolution.
english.nesnd_cne_respite_over_tt: No general reform pause is in effect.
english.nesnd_cne_respite_programs_tt: At least one reform is underway.
english.nesnd_cne_respite_confidence_tt: Public confidence is no higher than #v 900#!.

english.nesnd_postwar_sih_title: The Army of Shu Enters Nanjing
english.nesnd_postwar_sih_desc: Nanjing is in our hands, and the Zheng court can no longer hold the south together. Shu rose against Wu; victory has now placed the succession before its ruler. Some urge the return of the Ming sovereign. Others would have the Prince of Shu establish a Han dynasty of his own.
english.nesnd_postwar_hna_desc: The army of Xiangyang marched south under the banner of restoring Ming. The Assembly of Rites and the provinces now await a decision on the government. Restoring the Zhu would renew the dynasty’s authority, but republicans refuse to entrust the country to another ruling house. The gentry’s distrust of a republic has survived the fall of Zheng power.
english.nesnd_postwar_gng_desc: The ruling house of Huai bears the Zhu imperial lineage. With Nanjing secured, the court petitions its prince to take the imperial title and restore Ming authority. The divisions left by war remain, and the Assembly of Rites and the provinces will judge the restored court by what follows.
english.nesnd_postwar_restore_ming_option: Recall the Zhu and restore the Ming court.
english.nesnd_postwar_restore_ming_tt: Recall the deposed Ming emperor or his lawful heir first. If no eligible living royal can be found, establish a new dynast from the documented family line and restore the Ming name. Foreign sovereigns and heirs are not seized.
english.nesnd_postwar_great_han_option: Let the house of Han rise again.
english.nesnd_postwar_great_han_tt: Adopt the name Great Han, retaining our current sovereign.
english.nesnd_postwar_hna_republic_option: The country belongs to no ruling house.
english.nesnd_postwar_hna_republic_tt: Establish a republic. Sections of the gentry will resist its authority, while republican influence among the intelligentsia and urban middle classes grows.
english.nesnd_postwar_gng_option: Raise the Prince of Huai to the Ming throne.
english.nesnd_postwar_gng_tt: Restore Ming under Huai’s own Zhu line. If no eligible dynast of that branch survives, establish a new member following its documented generation names.
english.nesnd_postwar_wait_option: The succession must be considered again.
english.nesnd_postwar_wait_tt: No eligible living successor is available. Leave the constitution and ruler unchanged for now.

english.nesnd_small_states.2.far_south: Australia's population and processing centres now maintain effective links with local production in New Zealand. Working ports carry goods to market. These industries support the Far South's growth and provide revenue for local services.
english.nesnd_small_states.2.burma: Production in the upper country around $STATE_MANDALAY$ and the lower country at $STATE_PEGU$ now reaches the market through existing transport. Better earnings for farmers and merchants support livelihoods and give the government more room to provide administration and education.
english.nesnd_small_states.2.siam: Production outside Bangkok is now linked to the population and fiscal centre. The existing army still draws on national revenue, while local development raises the question of how administration and education should be distributed.
english.nesnd_small_states.6.far_south: Production and shipping now link Australia and New Zealand, while schools and public offices can sustain local services. The government has more revenue and trained personnel with which to conduct foreign affairs and plan development in both regions.
english.nesnd_small_states.6.burma: Production and public services have gained a stable footing in the upper country and the lower reaches around $STATE_PEGU$. Markets and transport linking the two have increased public revenue, while schools train new personnel. Burma can use these strengths to seek better terms abroad.
english.nesnd_small_states.6.siam: Production, public services and defence now connect Bangkok with the provinces. Government revenue must support the army as well as schools and local administration. Its allocation remains a matter of national debate.
english.nesnd_small_livelihood_journal_reason: Farmers, artisans and merchants bear the costs of rent, taxation and changing markets. Greater autonomy requires income from local production and people trained to staff schools and public offices. Foreign investment can bring money and expertise, and support from an overlord can ease the burden, but the country must still sustain itself through local work and enterprise.

english.nesnd_small_targets_lost: The selected regions no longer retain sufficient population or their actual centres. Regional work is paused. Restore the conditions or select two regions within the present territory.
english.nesnd_small_economy_journal_reason: Existing industries can sustain the country if they provide work, earn a profit and reach their markets.
english.nesnd_small_governance_journal_reason: The provinces need teachers, administrators and reliable public funding. Schools and government services must extend beyond the capital if more people are to gain an education and enter new occupations.
english.nesnd_small_regional_economy_journal_rea: The population center and the surrounding regions have different strengths in agriculture, mining, fishing, forestry and manufacturing. Transport links to the market can turn these resources into industries that supply and support one another.
english.nesnd_small_regional_governance_journal_: Public revenue must support more than the capital. Both regions need functioning administration, while schools and universities prepare residents for new occupations.
english.nesnd_small_order_journal_reason: Independence or extensive autonomy gives the government more authority, along with responsibility for trade, law and defence. Local producers need dependable customers, schools need funding, and the borders need reliable allies and troops.
english.nesnd_small_working_status: Conditions are met this month; observation can continue.
english.nesnd_small_paused_status: Some conditions are unmet this month. Previously earned qualifying months are retained.
english.nesnd_small_dispute_journal_reason: Hardship and restrictive laws have given a local movement support. The government may permit organisation, promise legal reform or use the police to suppress it. Each choice affects particular interests.
english.nesnd_small_dispute_status: The movement is seeking support. A promise of reform is fulfilled only by an actual change in law.
english.nesnd_small_public_desc: Administration and industry need people able to take on new duties. A year of public spending can help build those skills.
english.nesnd_small_public_tt: Pay the weekly quote fixed when the programme begins for 12 months. Qualifications and tax capacity receive temporary help. The programme cannot be cancelled early or duplicated.
english.nesnd_small_specialise_button_desc: Merchants and guilds seek wider outlets within the present market, with greater room to manage local business.
english.nesnd_small_specialise_button_tt: For 12 months, qualifications improve and authority falls by 25. The arrangement ends if the market owner changes or the country controls its own market.
english.nesnd_small_own_market_button: Prepare a Market of Our Own
english.nesnd_small_own_market_button_desc: Market autonomy requires more than permission: producers still need inputs, transport and customers.
english.nesnd_small_own_market_button_tt: Choose a 12-month policy without immediately changing market ownership. Public investment becomes available after actual market autonomy; qualifying industries must have no input shortages.
english.nesnd_small_retarget_button_desc: The government may reorganise production and services within its present territory, but the new arrangement must prove itself.
english.nesnd_small_retarget_button_tt: Select the largest state and remaining directly owned states as two regions. Current regional observation resets. Another revision is unavailable for 24 months; past rewards are not repeated.
english.nesnd_small_restore_geography_button_des: Recovered regions may rejoin the homeland programme, once current transport and services can support them.
english.nesnd_small_restore_geography_button_tt: Only valid original homeland groups and centres can be restored. Regional observation restarts, with the same 24-month interval.
english.nesnd_small_order_button_desc: Consolidate our laws, public services and defence.
english.nesnd_small_order_button_tt: Choose the objective matching current sovereignty and accumulate 24 qualifying months within 120 months. A change of sovereignty branch restarts observation; the shared reward is granted once.
english.nesnd_small_request_autonomy_desc: The local government seeks more authority on the strength of its practical achievements.
english.nesnd_small_request_autonomy_tt: Ask the actual direct overlord. Approval applies the native autonomy increase, verifies the outcome, reduces liberty desire and establishes a truce.
english.nesnd_small_request_independence_desc: The country seeks responsibility for its own affairs and must give the overlord practical grounds to agree.
english.nesnd_small_request_independence_tt: Ask the actual direct overlord for peaceful independence. Success requires actual independence; native diplomatic options remain available after refusal.
english.nesnd_small_request_market_desc: Controlling the market brings responsibility for supply and transport and requires the present market owner's agreement.
english.nesnd_small_request_market_tt: Request the native market-autonomy pact from the actual market owner. Verify real ownership; if the pact exists but the market has not recalculated, allow at most 30 days.
english.nesnd_small_defence_fra_desc: Mutual defence requires two independent countries and an effective treaty.
english.nesnd_small_defence_fra_tt: Propose a five-year defensive treaty. It counts only after approval and actual entry into force.
english.nesnd_small_defence_gbr_desc: Mutual defence requires two independent countries and an effective treaty.
english.nesnd_small_defence_gbr_tt: Propose a five-year defensive treaty. It counts only after approval and actual entry into force.

english.nesnd_small_defence_neighbour_tt: Review the selected neighbour before sending. Equal relations favour the country with higher GDP.
